visual.name: plumeStreamGraph
visual.description: Streamgraph with the Plume Studio look: flowing streams (wiggle), centered silhouette, 100% and stacked areas; largest streams in the middle or custom order; smooth edges; stream names written inside each stream where it is thickest, without overlap; hover to bring a stream forward, cross-filtering, legend, date axis, small multiples and a left-to-right reveal; premium: playback cursor, order by peak date, step edges, name-and-share labels, highlight risers and fallers, Top N and Others, edge values, reference period with change, event annotations from a measure, navigator and a playback cursor with live ranking.
